**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Spread children are not supported
```

## How to fix

Render the array as an expression child instead of spreading it: `{items}` or `{items.map((x) => <li>{x}</li>)}` (or `<For each={items}>`).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = (p: { items: any[] }) => <ul>{...p.items}</ul>;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = (p: { items: any[] }) => <ul>{p.items}</ul>;
```
